mentior

mentior, mentīrī, mentītus sum

verb, fourth conjugation, deponent · Conjugation on Wiktionary

lie, tell a lie

In this lexicon

  • lie

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. S. 2.6.32: nōn mentiar; Sen. Ep. 107.2: id est mentiāris; Traupman 339

Examples

  • dīc obsecrō hercle sēriō quod tē rogem, cavē mihi mendācī quicquam

    for heaven’s sake, answer me seriously what I ask you, and no lies, mindPlaut. Asin. 29–30
